title: VALUE DRIFTS: TRACING VALUE ALIGNMENT DUR-ING LLM POST-TRAINING
reasoning: The paper investigates the alignment of Large Language Models with human value systems. It introduces and utilizes an evaluation framework (V-PRISM) that specifically categorizes and measures model stances on topics including 'Religion and Spirituality Beliefs', 'Discussions on Abortion', and 'Ethics of Death and Penalty'.
